tasks.notes: Qoder scheduled tasks expire 7 days after generatedAt. Run the regenerator to extend them. Durable schedules (weekly external-link check, PR gate) live in .github/workflows/qoder-gate.yml and do not expire.

phases.what: Install scout (cloud setup script and computer). Set a spending cap on every ad account. Decide the test budget and the first 2–3 channels.
phases.doneWhen: /advisor shows Fable 5.2, and each account has a cap

phases.what: Two separate draft PRs, both first-party, with no pixel and no third-party script. FlyGACA: keep the first-visit utm_* tags in the browser, then store them with the account after any kind of signup, in a table erased with the account. Add a report query: signups and activated learners per campaign. Captain Adel: daily aggregate counts per campaign of visit and first_question, once per browser, with nothing stored per person.
phases.doneWhen: A test signup from a tagged link shows its campaign on FlyGACA, and a tagged first question shows in Captain Adel's daily counts. PRs: FlyGACA#367, Captain-Adel#144. Both merged; Captain Adel stores its counts in Supabase through increment_campaign_count (migration 0031). Before data flows: apply migrations 0030 and 0031, deploy, and set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY on Captain Adel's Vercel project.

phases.what: Connect read-only: Google's official server is read-only, and Snapchat's is reported read-only. Meta uses a view-only login. Claude writes a weekly report across channels: spend, clicks, signups, activated learners, cost per activated learner.
phases.doneWhen: Two weekly reports match the platform dashboards

phases.what: 2–3 channels, the same budget each, a fixed window (for example 14 days). Copy goes through the checker, then the owner reviews it and publishes in the platform UI.
phases.doneWhen: Each channel has a cost per activated learner

phases.what: Keep the channels under the owner's target cost per activated learner and stop the rest. Only then consider letting Claude make paused drafts through a write-enabled login.

decisions.text: Test budget per channel and total cap. No figure is written anywhere in this repo on purpose.
Approval of the phase 1 UTM-capture PRs in FlyGACA and Captain-Adel.
Confirmed prices, before any ad for a paid plan.
A PDPL review (ksa-compliance / privacy-dpia) before any pixel, Conversions API or customer-list upload.
Influencer or creator ads, if wanted: check Saudi media-licensing rules with counsel first.
